name: StatementCycle
description: A monthly billing cycle record for a CreditCardAccount. Created by SVC-003 at the close of each billing period. Records: opening and closing balances, interest charged, minimum payment due, and payment due date. Also records the persistent debt counter snapshot for FCA CONC 6.7.27 compliance. Immutable append-only record — never updated after creation.

fields.name: statement_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601. Date the billing cycle closed. Immutable.

fields.name: opening_balance
fields.validation_rule: Required. GBP. Balance at start of cycle (equals prior cycle's closing_balance). Non-negative.

fields.name: closing_balance
fields.validation_rule: Required. GBP. Balance at end of cycle after all transactions and payments. Non-negative.

fields.name: interest_charged
fields.validation_rule: Required. GBP. Interest accrued during cycle. 0.00 if full balance paid in prior cycle (interest-free period).

fields.name: fees_charged
fields.validation_rule: Required. GBP. Fees charged during cycle (annual fee pro-rated, late payment fee if applicable). Non-negative.

fields.name: payments_received
fields.validation_rule: Required. GBP. Total payments received during cycle. Non-negative.

fields.name: minimum_payment_due
fields.validation_rule: Required. GBP. Must cover all interest + fees + minimum principal (CONC 7.7). Cannot be set so low that balance grows absent a freeze on interest (CONC 7.7.7).

fields.name: payment_due_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601. Minimum 25 days after statement_date (FCA CONC minimum). Must not be a UK bank holiday.

fields.name: persistent_debt_months
fields.validation_rule: Required. Non-negative integer. Snapshot of ENT-023.persistent_debt_months at this statement date. FCA CONC 6.7.27 audit evidence.
fields.transparency_note: FCA CONC 6.7 audit evidence. Retained account lifetime + 6 years for regulatory inspection.

relationships.description: StatementCycle belongs to one CreditCardAccount via account_id FK.

design_decisions.decision: StatementCycle is immutable and append-only. Never updated after creation.
design_decisions.rationale: Regulatory audit trail. FCA CONC and CCA 1974 require complete billing history. Immutable records also support idempotent statement generation.

design_decisions.decision: persistent_debt_months snapshotted onto StatementCycle at creation.
design_decisions.rationale: Provides complete, auditable history of the persistent debt counter. Supports FCA supervision evidence of interventions at correct thresholds.
